description: This file is a documentation Markdown file describing the Composite Input HAL interface, its architecture, operation, capabilities, and usage guidelines. It provides an overview, resource management, event handling, property querying, system context, and other detailed specifications for the composite video input component in the platform.

classes.name: PlatformCapabilities
classes.description: Defines supported features and capabilities of the composite input platform, including available ports, features, and property support.

classes.name: PortCapabilities
classes.description: Specifies the capabilities of an individual composite input port, such as supported properties and whether metrics are available.

classes.name: PortStatus
classes.description: Represents the current status of a port, including connection state, signal status, and video mode.

classes.name: SignalStatus
classes.description: Enum representing different signal statuses, such as NO_SIGNAL, UNSTABLE, STABLE, and NOT_SUPPORTED.

classes.name: VideoResolution
classes.description: Contains information about the video resolution, standard detection, and interlacing status.

classes.name: PortMetrics
classes.description: Telemetry data for a port, including signal lock time, drops, uptime, and reset timestamp.

classes.name: PropertyKVPair
classes.description: A key-value pair used for batch property queries and setting properties.

classes.name: PropertyMetadata
classes.description: Metadata describing a property, such as type, read-only flag, metric flag, and description.

methods.name: getPlatformCapabilities
methods.description: Returns platform-wide capabilities, supported features, and port list.

methods.name: getPortIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available composite input port IDs.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns an interface for controlling and querying a specific port by ID.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns the capabilities of a specific port.

methods.name: getPortInfo
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about a port, such as name and description.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Query a specific property value from a port.

methods.name: getPropertyMulti
methods.description: Batch retrieve multiple property values from a port for efficiency.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Obtain telemetry metrics from a port if supported.

methods.name: registerTelemetryListener
methods.description: Register a listener for telemetry updates for ports supporting metrics.
